<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013112026-09-2503-39-52" status="unreviewed">gal te yang rgyun la mi slu ba yod pas de'i rdzas la tshad ma yin no ces ni brjod mi nus te 
         <note type="gloss">yang ji ltar bzhed cha med | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang</rs> <rs type="person">tsha</rs> gnyis rgyu 'bras kun rdzob tu gzhan du snang ba tsam khas blangs pas chog gsung ste <rs type="school">dbu chen</rs> ltar na gzhan du snang ba nyid kyang mi 'dod par mngon no || 'o na pha bu'am me du tha dad du snang ba zhe na | snang ba de gnyis rgyu 'bras ma yin te gnyis dus mnyam pa med cing snang ba'i rgyu 'gag zin to ||</note> 
         ha cang thal  <lb n="10b2"/>ba'i phyir ro || </seg></TEI>
